description: Hybrid L0 overview / Fleet Command Center. First screen: status strip, compact First Action route, and Inputs evidence matrix above fold. Aggregate-first triage; exact run forensics via Run Explorer and Trust. run_id is HTTP identity context only — never a Prometheus label.

panels.title: Triage Alert State
panels.description: DUX6: UNKNOWN = evidence incomplete (missing/stale/not-started/backend-error/selection). Pair with Provenance reason + action; never read as OK. DUX5: Value columns labelled as Severity (no bare Value # headers). Actual Prometheus alert-state triage for firing and pending BioETL rules. This panel reads the Prometheus `ALERTS` series and does not duplicate alert business logic in dashboard queries; inactive/no-alert state is rendered as an explicit zero row. Critical/page severity is red, warning is amber, and inactive aggregate evidence is neutral. Open 2. Runtime for alert-condition and blocker scope (Alerts & SLO dashboard retired).

options.content:
What is broken or degraded right now, and where should the operator drill down first? Status → First Action → Inputs · $workflow/$pipeline/$run_type/run $run_id
UNKNOWN = evidence incomplete. Prefer First Action over raw numbers.

panels.description: DUX5: status-card shell (reason/action beside Status; no internal scroll). DUX4-10: Scope legend — NOW=current, RANGE=window, RUN=exact run_id (HTTP), WORKFLOW/GLOBAL=blast radius/fleet. Family: HEALTH|EXEC|EVIDENCE|IMPACT|APPLICABILITY. DUX3 scope legend: NOW=current, RANGE=selected window, RUN=exact run_id HTTP, WORKFLOW/GLOBAL=blast radius/fleet. L0 v3 scope/provenance banner. Primary question: what is broken now and where should the operator drill down first? Scope: workflow=$workflow, pipeline=$pipeline, run_type=$run_type, run_id=$run_id, selected Grafana time range. Provenance: shipped Prometheus current-status recording rules plus selected-range evidence. Verdict grammar: state x confidence x basis x next_action. Known limitation: first-screen PromQL remains pipeline/run_type-scoped; workflow is context/evidence-first, and run_id is resolved from persisted control-plane manifests. run_id is local control-plane identity context only.
panels.title: Provenance
Status
panels.description: DUX6: UNKNOWN = evidence incomplete (missing/stale/not-started/backend-error/selection). Pair with Provenance reason + action; never read as OK. DUX5: UNKNOWN = evidence incomplete (missing/stale/not-started/backend-error); pair with Provenance reason + action. Not a healthy OK. DUX4-16: First strip = health + evidence/freshness proxy + action; blast radius via Inputs/alerts. DUX3-20: Composite NOW health. Pair with Inputs + First Action; domain matrix stays collapsed. Composite fleet verdict (state x confidence x basis). Current L0 fleet status (bioetl_l0_status). 0=OK, 1=WARN, >=2=CRIT, null=UNKNOWN. Confidence is low when series is absent (UNKNOWN). Evidence age follows the recording/refresh window, not range history. Primary action is First Action; deeper proof is on domain boards. Empty Inputs with Status=OK is VALID_EMPTY fleet. null Status is TELEMETRY_ABSENT_OR_STALE/UNKNOWN, not OK. Domain tables are collapsed matrix detail, not peer first-screen badges.

panels.title: First Action
panels.description: DUX5: Value columns labelled as Count (no bare Value # headers). DUX4-16: First strip = health + evidence/freshness proxy + action; blast radius via Inputs/alerts. DUX3-20: ≤4 actionable CTAs with time/vars preserved. Ranked next-best-action (<=4). Prefer domain handoff with scope preserved. Not a multi-paragraph runbook. Open Incident when multi-domain; domain board for localization.

panels.title: Inputs
panels.description: DUX5: Value columns labelled as Count (no bare Value # headers). DUX4-16: First strip = health + evidence/freshness proxy + action; blast radius via Inputs/alerts. DUX3-20: Domain input evidence / freshness proxies for first-screen confidence. Compact L0 input summary for the selected pipeline/run_type scope. Rows are shown in the canonical operator order: Control Plane, Runtime, Provider, Data Quality, Data Validation, Workflow. Status values are OK (0), WARN (1), CRIT (2), or UNKNOWN (3/null). Use the panel links to open the matching drilldown; Workflow resets scope on handoff. This is the deviation-first first-level matrix; the six repeated subsystem cards are available only in the collapsed Diagnostics & Docs row. Phase-2: status cells use color-background thresholds (OK/WARN/CRIT). Not peer-comparable to Range evidence elsewhere.

panels.title: Runtime Blockers Trend
panels.description: Selected-range L1 runtime evidence for the active pipeline/run_type scope. This compact trend is below the current verdict path and does not determine L0 Status or First Action. Shows OK (0), WARN (1), CRIT (2), or UNKNOWN (3/null); missing series or gaps remain diagnostic and must not be treated as OK. Open Runtime for detailed blocker conditions.

panels.title: DQ Status Trend
panels.description: Selected-range L1 Data Quality evidence for the active pipeline/run_type scope. This compact trend is below the current verdict path and does not determine L0 Status or First Action. Renders discrete OK/WARN/CRIT/UNKNOWN states; numeric values are hidden from the operator view. missing series or gaps remain diagnostic and must not be treated as OK. Open Data Quality for detailed DQ conditions.

panels.title: Gold Lifecycle Trend
panels.description: DUX6: zero/empty = none observed, Not started, or Not available — never bare success; red only for validated failure (not lifecycle zero). Selected-range L1 data-validation lifecycle evidence for the active pipeline/run_type scope. This compact trend is below the current verdict path and does not determine L0 Status or First Action. Legend includes pipeline/run_type/lifecycle_state; disabled Gold stage returns OK as a valid non-error state. Missing series or gaps remain diagnostic and must not be treated as OK. Open Runtime for lifecycle-state detail or Control Plane for replay/manifest context.

panels.title: Historical Failures
panels.description: DUX5: Value columns labelled as Count (no bare Value # headers). Selected-range historical failure evidence only. Keeps pipeline and run_type labels from the active Grafana window and remains below the current verdict path; it does not determine L0 Status or First Action. Zero matching rows means no failed-run samples in the selected range, not proof that the current scope is OK. Open Runtime for failed-run and blocker localization.

panels.title: Recent Terminal Runs
panels.description: DUX6: raw paths hidden; use Open/report artifact for full path (short scan). DUX5: Value columns labelled as Count (no bare Value # headers). Selected-range terminal-run evidence only. Shows non-success terminal statuses grouped by pipeline so the evidence table stays readable without scroll while preserving the active Grafana time window. This panel is below the current verdict path and does not determine L0 Status or First Action; no terminal rows is not proof that the current scope is OK. Open Control Plane for manifest/terminal-run proof or Runtime for execution localization.

panels.title: Silver Rejects + Rate
panels.description: DUX6: zero/empty = none observed, Not started, or Not available — never bare success; red only for validated failure (not lifecycle zero). DUX5: zero means none observed or Not started/Not available — never bare success; red only on validated failure. Range silver rejects evidence — NOT a peer fleet health KPI. Handoff: Data Quality accounting + Run Explorer for exact-run counts.

panels.title: Diagnostics & Docs (Logs / Traces / Raw Metrics)
panels.description: Domain status matrix detail (Control Plane / Runtime / DQ / Provider / Validation / Workflow) plus diagnostics nav. Collapsed by default — first screen uses Status + Inputs + First Action only (DSA-02).
Operator note for raw metric starting points and cross-dashboard diagnostics handoffs; no datasource query is expected.

options.content:
Raw metric starting points for this dashboard are
System Status: bioetl_l0_status{pipeline=~"chembl_assay",run_type=~"incremental"},
First Action route: bioetl_l0_next_action_route{pipeline=~"chembl_assay",run_type=~"incremental"},
Input Status: bioetl_l0_input_status_selected{pipeline=~"chembl_assay",run_type=~"incremental"}.
Exact blocker reasons live in the Control Plane, Runtime, Data Quality, Provider Health, and Workflow dashboards.
Historical evidence stays in the row above.
